windows.60: Over the past 60 days, several visitors have expressed dissatisfaction with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Common issues include limited menu options, poor food quality, and long wait times, with some guests reporting that the kitchen was backed up and orders were not being taken for extended periods. The grab-and-go option has been the only available choice late in the day, which has disappointed some visitors expecting a fuller menu. While the overall rating remains above 4, these service and food-related concerns have been the main sources of critical feedback.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service problems included long wait times and periods when kitchen orders were not being taken, causing frustration. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the cafe’s offerings and operations need attention to better meet visitor expectations.
